read.thesis: Q3 revenue up 10% to €6,413m and RCO up 9% to €1,281m; FY26 RCO guide €3.40–3.65bn confirmed, with no capacity additions or utilisation figures disclosed.

triggers.label: Q3 revenue +10% to €6,413m
triggers.quote: the company increased its revenue noticeably by €606 million or 10% to €6,413 million
triggers.highlight: increased its revenue noticeably by €606 million or 10%

triggers.label: Extra €300m savings to 2028
triggers.quote: The company targets additional savings of €300 million, which are to be realised in nearly equal parts in 2027 and 2028.

triggers.label: Ranville plant closure in France
triggers.quote: Heidelberg Materials announced on 16 September that it would close its Ranville site in France.
triggers.highlight: close its Ranville site in France

guidance.quote: Heidelberg Materials continues to expect the result from current operations (RCO) to be between €3.40 billion and €3.65 billion.
ROIC is forecast to remain slightly above 10%.

guidance.quote: specific net CO₂ emissions per tonne of cementitious material to remain around the previous year’s level
